text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Race day. The crowd eagerly anticipates 
Mr. C.B.'s victory. Katsuragi Ace rejoices 
at this, fired up with determination.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Planning to take on the Classic Triple 
Crown route, she eagerly looks forward to 
competing against Mr. C.B. there.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before the race, Mr. C.B. was humming to 
herself. Her heart raced with anticipation 
as she pondered what kind of race she 
would run.
